rational-method: Line chart, rational method with SYNTHETIC inputs: peak flow in cubic metres per second rises in a straight line with rainfall intensity from 5 to 80 millimetres per hour. Three lines for runoff coefficients 0.2, 0.35 and 0.6 reach about 4, 7 and 12 cubic metres per second at 80 millimetres per hour; an orange dot marks the worked example at 40 millimetres per hour, about 3.6 cubic metres per second on the 0.35 line.
scs-cn: Line chart, SCS curve number 75 with SYNTHETIC inputs: runoff depth in millimetres stays at zero until the storm depth passes the initial abstraction of 16.9 millimetres (dashed vertical line), then rises as a curve to about 57 millimetres at 120 millimetres of rain. Two dots mark the demo storms: 40 millimetres of rain gives about 4.9 millimetres of runoff and 80 millimetres gives about 26.9.
